page.content:
Anna is a fictional air hostess. A minor character, she appeared briefly in the 2008 James Bond film Quantum of Solace, portrayed by British actress and singer, Rachel McDowall.

Who is Anna?

Anna is a fictional air hostess. A minor character, she appeared briefly in the 2008 James Bond film Quantum of Solace, portrayed by British actress and singer, Rachel McDowall.
